mapper.select: SELECT member_id AS memberId, performance_title AS performanceTitle, #{year} AS year, #{month} AS month, #{now} AS settlementMonthlyCreatedAt, SUM(settlement_weekly_sales_amount) AS monthlySalesAmount, SUM(settlement_weekly_refund_amount) AS monthlyRefundAmount, SUM(settlement_weekly_gross_amount) AS monthlyGrossAmount, SUM(settlement_weekly_commission) AS monthlyCommission, SUM(settlement_weekly_net_amount) AS monthlyNetAmount FROM settlement_weekly WHERE COALESCE(settlement_weekly_updated_at, settlement_weekly_created_at) > #{lastTimeSeconds} AND settlement_year = #{year} AND settlement_month = #{month} GROUP BY member_id, performance_title
